children: Dairy producer's H1 sales fell 18% yr/yr to EUR 173.2 mln
Net profit for H1 declined slightly, but net profitability improved to 5.58%
H1 EBITDA decreased to EUR 15.8 mln from EUR 17.7 mln a year earlier
AB Rokiškio sūris targets a 5% annual increase in milk bought and processed and a 3% net annual yield
DAIRY PRICE DEFLATION – H1 sales fell 18.25% to EUR173.2 mln, largely as lower dairy-product prices reduced selling prices across markets
FERMENTED CHEESE DECLINE – Sales volumes fell 10% and value sales dropped 24% for fermented cheeses, the Group's largest revenue category
RAW-MILK COST RELIEF – Cost of sales fell 20.7% to EUR148.5 mln as lower volumes and raw-milk purchase prices offset revenue pressure
The stock recently traded at 35 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 35 three months ago
Aug 31 - Lithuanian asset manager Invalda's H1 net profit drops
